rationale: Enumerated all combinations of 2 locations from 4 candidates. The combination [n1, n2] maximizes the objective function: sum over sections of (annual_fault_rate * customers_interrupted * max_gain_among_selected). For each section, the maximum gain is: s12=max(18,6)=18, s23=max(16,28)=28, s24=max(15,26)=26, s45=max(14,23)=23. Total expected customer-minutes saved = 0.18*120*18 + 0.14*70*28 + 0.12*90*26 + 0.09*40*23 = 388.8 + 274.4 + 280.8 + 82.8 = 1026.8.
